title: fissile finding record
description: One overflow finding emitted by `fissile check` and `fissile audit` (FS-004-check-audit.1). The byte-stable fields a human and an agent both read (GOAL-003-friendly-output.1, GOAL-004-token-thrift.1).

unit.description: The unit the matched rule measures in.

limit.description: The crossed soft or hard limit in `unit`.

severity.description: `hard` fails the commit; `soft` warns unless a staged history-proven edit count reaches its soft edit limit (GOAL-006-graded-limits, FS-004-check-audit.1.4).

rule_id.description: The rule that selected the budget and message.

message_id.description: The stable ID of the configured remediation message.

exception_would_accept.description: The ceiling a `fissile exception add` with no `--max` would record for this file: the measurement quantized up to the unit's `[exceptions.bump]` step (FS-004-check-audit.1, DF-006-quantized-ceilings.1). Omitted where that call would be refused, and absent from silenced `audit` records.

exception_max.description: Present only on silenced `audit` records: the maximum value the exception accepts.

soft_edit_count.description: The current staged edit plus the proven continuous committed over-soft edits for this rule. Present only on staged soft findings (FS-004-check-audit.1.4).

soft_edit_limit.description: The effective per-rule count at which a history-complete staged soft finding blocks. Present only on staged soft findings (FS-004-check-audit.1.4).

soft_edit_history_complete.description: Whether Git history proves the continuous run back to a reset or absence. False disables promotion (FS-004-check-audit.1.4).

promotion.description: Present only when a history-complete staged soft finding reached its edit limit and therefore blocks (FS-004-check-audit.1.4).
